items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Billie Holiday, you know, Bessie Smith, so many sad stories.

ctx.x: Yeah, G.E.D. Before G.E.D. they had what they call High School Equivalency. She got that, and then there was this college program called SEEK which was a state program. She got in that, she got a bachelors, you know, in education. And we said, “Okay Mom proved a point.” Next thing we know she’s in grad school. She wound up with a masters in Library Science and wound up working for the Erie County Library System until she was about — well her health prevented her from working past I think 64, 65.
